chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 288 – Ji Ning Refines the Aquatic Palace & Discovers Juhua’s Legendary Treasures
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning uses his Primaltwin to finally refine the aquatic palace, unlocking its core nexus and a mountain of treasures—but two of Celestial Immortal Juhua’s three legendary Immortal artifacts are missing.
og_description: Ji Ning refines the aquatic palace, unlocks a meditation chamber worth a Pure Yang treasure, and discovers that only one of Juhua’s three top-tier Immortal-ranked artifacts remains.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch288: Ji Ning Refines the Aquatic Palace & Discovers Juhua’s Lost Treasures
twitter_description: Ji Ning refines the aquatic palace, calms his Dao-heart on a legendary jade bed, and finds that two of Celestial Immortal Juhua’s three supreme treasures have vanished—where did they go?

lore_anchors.definition: A second soul-body created by a cultivator, capable of independent cultivation and acting as a separate entity. Ji Ning’s Primaltwin is pure Ki Refining.
A mid-range sword formation technique using multiple flying swords in concert. Ji Ning can only reach the eighth layer even with his improved ki.
A Buddhist formation ranked among the top mind-calming formations in the Three Realms, personally set up by Daoist Threelives in the aquatic palace’s meditation chamber.
A jade bed from the depths of the Nine Netherworlds, worth a Pure Yang treasure, used for calming the mind and tempering the Dao-heart.
A magic treasure of the highest grade, surpassing Earth and Heaven-ranked treasures. Top-grade Immortal-ranked artifacts are legendary.
A top-grade Immortal-ranked treasure containing the ancient Su River. It can trap enemies and weaken them while empowering the master.
A top-grade Immortal-ranked seal crafted from materials gathered across nine major worlds, used for smashing enemies with brute force.
A top-grade Immortal-ranked flying sword forged by Juhua after slaying the Thousand Sword Immortal. It is the only one of Juhua’s three treasures still in the aquatic palace.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did only one of Juhua’s three Immortal-ranked treasures remain?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter does not reveal yet. The other two—the Su River Scroll and the Nine Realms Seal—have mysteriously vanished, a deliberate cliffhanger.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the point of the meditation chamber?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It houses the core nexus of the aquatic palace. Refining it grants Ji Ning basic control over the entire estate and serves as a Dao-heart training ground.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the black ox actually the Thousand Ox Sword?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. The yellow-furred bear states that the only remaining Immortal-ranked treasure is the Thousand Ox Sword, which has taken the form of the black ox as its artifact spirit.
